notes.title: v1.02
notes.content:
Hello. I am back with some more changes and bug fixes:

- Increased speed in which a minute passes from 4 seconds/min to 2.5 seconds/min.
- Many crows will now spawn earlier.
- Fixed a bug where patrol wouldn't spawn until 1 AM.

Hopefully these changes will make the game feel more threatening towards the beginning so it doesn't
get boring! 

Please report bugs to me at this email: xtremebluefire@gmail.com
Thanks.

notes.title: v1.01
notes.content:
- Patrol will now always activate at the start.
- Ventor will now make noise.
- Added a version number in the bottom left of the main menu.
- Fixed a bug that caused the intro sequence to not play.


If there are any more bugs to be reported, please contact me at this email:
xtremebluefire@gmail.com
